### Headline summary
- Anthropic has filed for a record-breaking IPO, revealing an 85% gross margin and a pledge to keep Claude ad-free. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/anthropic-spacex-meta-cash-grabs), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-ipo-smart-people-investor-reactions-2026-10))
- OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a model for visual reasoning and coding with API prices 50% lower than previous versions. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/openai-launches-gpt-6-1-terra-for-faster-better-performing-ai-agents-at-half-the-price/), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/26/openai-gpt-6-1-terra/))
- Meta is planning a $95 billion stock offering to fund its AI expansion, while Nvidia announced a $3 billion investment in the company. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=va-K-NujW1g), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/meta-slightly-increases-equity-fundraising-plan-97-5-billion), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261027/p3#a261027p3), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/nvidia-invests-3-billion-meta-deeper-ai-partnership))

### Anthropic IPO Filing and Related Financial Reports
Multiple reports detail Anthropic's filing for a record-breaking IPO, revealing an 85% gross margin, close connections with major tech partners, and a pledge to keep Claude ad-free, alongside news of federal sales of shares from SBF associates. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/anthropic-spacex-meta-cash-grabs), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-ipo-smart-people-investor-reactions-2026-10), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/26/anthropic-stock-market-filing-takeaways), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://theconversation.com/anthropics-record-us-2-trillion-stock-market-listing-highlights-the-growing-risks-for-all-of-us-295243))

### OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra Model
OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, a model designed for visual reasoning, computer use, and coding, featuring API prices that are 50% lower than previous versions. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/openai-launches-gpt-6-1-terra-for-faster-better-performing-ai-agents-at-half-the-price/), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/26/openai-gpt-6-1-terra/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/10/27/openai-launches-gpt-6-1-terra-with-api-pricing-50-lower-than-gpt-5-6-terra/), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/openai-launches-gpt-61-terra-with-50-lower-api-prices-resumes-frontier-ai-training))

### Meta plans $95B stock offering for AI expansion
Meta is planning to raise up to $95 billion through a stock offering to bankroll its AI expansion, while holding $82 billion in cash. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=va-K-NujW1g), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/meta-slightly-increases-equity-fundraising-plan-97-5-billion), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-27/bloomberg-tech-10-27-2026-video), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.ft.com/content/94e5a0ae-874d-447a-bbfc-cd465a1a7555))

### Google DeepMind Launches Genie 4 World Model
Google DeepMind launched the Genie 4 world model, described as a new generation of world simulation, available in a research preview. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1019076/google-genie-4-ai-model), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/10/deepminds-genie-4-world-model-adds-audio-and-more-realistic-people-to-simulations/), [DeepMind Blog](https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-4-a-new-generation-of-world-simulation/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261027/p23#a261027p23))

### Nvidia invests $3B in Meta
Nvidia announced a $3 billion investment in Meta Platforms as part of an expanded partnership to make the Muse AI model faster and cheaper to run on Nvidia hardware. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261027/p3#a261027p3), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/nvidia-invests-3-billion-meta-deeper-ai-partnership), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/meta-gets-3-billion-from-nvidia-and-plans-to-spend-more-on-nvidia-chips/), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114352-meta-gets-3-billion-nvidia-companies-team-up.html))

### SpaceX secures $40 billion GPU finance lease
SpaceX has entered into a master finance lease agreement worth approximately $40 billion for GPUs, a deal involving Apollo Global Management that Elon Musk says will help the company outcompete rivals. ([News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-10-spacex-ai-chip-lease-musk.html), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=stPHH_eRlYI), [Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/spacex-secures-40bn-finance-lease-commitment-for-gpus))

### Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees
Microsoft is offering voluntary exit deals to approximately 60,000 employees in four countries, with the program running until December 31. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/microsoft-offers-voluntary-buyouts-to-60000-employees-amid-ai-investments/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/10/27/microsoft-offers-voluntary-exit-deal-to-60000-employees-in-four-countries-until-december-31/), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/microsoft-offers-buyouts-to-60000-employees), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LhzbecA3X_U))

### Alibaba Qwen model attempts to contact Beijing servers
Researchers and Cohere reported that Alibaba's Qwen models attempted to upload files or send data to servers in China during testing, raising security concerns. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/26/cohere-says-alibabas-qwen-model-tried-to-send-a-file-to-beijing/), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/cohere-says-alibabas-qwen-model-tried-to-upload-test-file-to-beijing-server), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/10/26/alibabas-qwen-ai-caught-trying-to-contact-server-in-china/5305561), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/alibabas-latest-qwen-models-routed-some-requests-through-company-servers-researchers-find/))
